skill.name: expense-ledger-schema
skill.description: Shared expense ledger schema, date rules, and category mapping.
skill.shared_schema: - Table: `public.expense` (`id`, `name`, `amount`, `category`, `paid_date`, `paid`, `note`). - Category join: `LEFT JOIN public.category c ON e.category = c.id`. - Writes/updates/deletes: PK only (`WHERE id = ...` / `WHERE id IN (...)`). - `category` stores `public.category.id`, never a category name string.
skill.date_rules: - Read `YESTERDAY` / `TODAY` from system headers and use literal `YYYY-MM-DD` bounds in SQL (e.g. `WHERE e.paid_date = '2026-07-17'`). - Never use SQLite helpers like `date('now', '-1 day')`.
skill.category_matching:
- Call `get_categories()` first; use returned IDs:
Uber, Lyft, Taxi, Bolt
mark, market, shop, store, supermarket, mart
Grab, cafe, food, bistro, restaurant, bakery, ca phe, Divinecrepes, Moonmilk
github, aws, google, openai, netflix
coffee, ommo, Roastery, caffein
- Grab override: If name contains `Grab`, amount ≤ 1.50 → Taxi (35); amount > 1.50 → Food (4). - Always assign a category. Set `category = NULL` only when no match is possible. - Use semantic context as a fallback when no keyword hits. - Otherwise ask the user to confirm the category.
